newsitem.title: CHINA: COSCO Pac, LCH soars after trade resumes.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Pac, LCH soars after trade resumes.

text.p: Shares in COSCO Pacific Ltd and Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd surged on Tuesday after trading resumed following news the China-backed container leasing firm planned to buy a 20 percent stake in the bank.
"This is a mutually benefical deal," said Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities.
COSCO Pacific shares were up HK$3.00 to HK$18.80 after hitting a high HK$19.20.
Liu Chong Hing added HK$0.70 to HK$25.00.
COSCO Pacific said the deal helped to diversify its shipping related business into financial servcies.

COSCO Pacific said it would buy a 17.25 percent stake in Liu Chong Hing Bank from Liu Chong Hing Estate Co Ltd -- a wholly owned unit of Liu Chong Hing Investment Ltd -- and the Liu family for HK$1.65 billion, or HK$23.88 per share.
The company said it would acquire a further 20 million shares in Liu Chong Hing Bank from its parent COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd.
Analysts said they expected the family-run Liu Chong Hing Bank to benefit from the infusion of funds and COSCO Pacific's good connections in China.
As part of the deal, Liu Chong Hing Bank will issue about 45 million shares worth HK$1.07 billion to Liu Chong Hing Estate.
COSCO Pacific and Liu Chong Hing Investment shares were suspended from trading last Friday.
Liu Chong Hing Bank shares were suspended last Thursday. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6369
